failure.label: Failure Cases (CTP fails while hard preservation recovers)
failure.selection_rule: rank test patches by |{pixel: CTP != GT AND guard == GT AND GT != ignore}| (CTP fails while hard text-preservation recovers the pixel); take top n

representative.label: Representative Cases (seed-42 random, informative filter)
representative.selection_rule: rng(seed=42) draw without replacement from test patches whose GT contains >= 1% unsupported-class pixels (informative filter); take min(n=4, pool size)

targeted_recovery.label: Targeted Recovery Cases (existing top-5, directory outputs/potsdam_qualitative_v0 unchanged)
targeted_recovery.selection_rule: rank by pixel count where C2 wrong AND CTP == GT for GT classes in {car, low_vegetation, tree}; take top-k; fixed before viewing

note: Selection rules were fixed BEFORE viewing panels; no cherry-picking by results except the pre-registered ranking rules.
